recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12662 unless a future QA run reports a new Flag ordering problem.
issue_request: FHIR-12662 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU2 reporting that Flag resource elements were out of W5 order. The requested order was identifier, status, category, code, subject, period, encounter, author instead of identifier, category, status, period, subject, encounter, author, code.
initial_application: Historical commit fd96fa1d815117d335e22713f30f6792a9c83b1d includes '#12662 Flag w5 order' in its subject and reordered the then-authoritative Flag spreadsheet rows so status moved before category, code moved before subject, and period followed subject.
additional_context: Flag is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The old spreadsheet source has since been replaced by source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml, whose current differential lists the original FHIR-12662 elements in the requested order. A later supportingInfo element is appended after author and does not conflict with the original W5-order correction. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later substantive conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already reflects the requested Flag element order, and suppressed QA messages contain no current Flag element-order warning.
